decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extensions by reason of its design, excessive size, position and appearance would result in a loss of balance out of character with the existing pair of semi-detached houses detrimental to the visual amenity of the street scene and would have an adverse impact on residential amenity of the adjoining properties. The proposal is contrary to policies H3.4 and ENV 1.1 of the Unitary Development Plan and policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan.
description: Demolition of existing rear extension, demolition of exiting garage and erection of two storey and single storey side garage extension and single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
